nagoya-arimatsu.name: Arimatsu historic townscape

nagoya-castle.name: Nagoya Castle
nagoya-castle.approx_cost: ¥1,000 adults since 1 Oct 2026 (was ¥500); junior high school students and younger free; tickets bought at the old price stay valid
nagoya-castle.hours: 9:00-16:30 (last entry 16:00); extended hours during seasonal festivals (e.g. 9:00-19:30 from 19 Sep to 4 Oct 2026)
nagoya-castle.best_season: Spring (cherry blossoms, Spring Festival) and autumn (Autumn Festival with evening opening)
nagoya-castle.address_local: 〒462-0845 愛知県名古屋市中区城見通名城二丁目大津通

nagoya-festival.name: Nagoya Festival
nagoya-festival.recurrence: yearly, on a weekend in October (2 days)

editions.note: 72nd edition; main venue Hisaya-odori Park. The procession of the three unifiers was not held because of the Asian Para Games; floats of the three unifiers were displayed instead (17 Oct 18:00-20:00, 18 Oct 17:00-19:00). Nagoya Castle admission was free both days.

closed.irregular: Year-end and maintenance closures (e.g. 9-23 Jun 2026); open on Tuesdays during long school holidays

tokyo-to-nagoya.name: Tokyo ↔ Nagoya
tokyo-to-nagoya.approx_cost: Tokaido Shinkansen Nozomi about 1h33-1h40, reserved seat ¥11,300 (regular season; one guide lists ¥10,880). The reserved surcharge rises to ¥11,880 from 1 Jul 2027; unreserved prices stay the same. Kodama about 2h40; JR Central Tours 'Platt Kodama' package from ¥8,710.
